inspection.locked: Finish the scene and clear the nearby encounter before inspecting.
inspection.shutter_closed: Inspection shutter: closed (test complete after closing)
inspection.shutter_open: Inspection shutter: open — press E again to close
guide.interact: Follow the gold marker. Move with WASD / left stick; look with the mouse / right stick. Approach and press E / Y to interact.
guide.dialogue: Press E / Y to continue the conversation. When choices appear, use Up/Down and Enter / A, or click a response.
guide.training_hits: Face the practice post at the gold marker and land three sword hits: left mouse / J / X. Move closer if a swing misses.
guide.training_dodge: Dodge once with Space / A. The practice post does not attack; you can dodge now.
guide.training_arc: Cast Jade Sword Arc with 1 / D-pad Up.
guide.training_ward: Cast Flowing Ward with 2 / D-pad Right.
guide.recover: Recover at the sanctuary shrine marked in gold. Approach and press E / Y.
guide.read: Read the marked document: approach and press E / Y. Close the record with Esc / Menu to continue.
guide.exit: Use the marked room gateway: approach and press E / Y to enter the next room.
guide.fight: Defeat the enemies in this room, then use the marked gateway. Sword: left mouse / J / X. Dodge: Space / A.
guide.blessing: Choose one blessing before leaving. Use Up/Down and Enter / A, or click an option. If the offer is closed, interact with the room gateway.
guide.shutter: Test the marked inspection shutter: press E / Y to open it, close the record, then interact again to shut it.
guide.return: Return to the sanctuary using the marked shrine: approach and press E / Y.
